natural: Going at it with all one's strength

meaning.en: To go all out; to put everything one has into something.
meaning.zh: 把全部力量都投入进去，尽最大努力去做。

examples.zh: 离比赛只剩一周了，队员们都在全力以赴地训练。
examples.en: With only a week to go before the match, the players are training flat out.

examples.zh: 这个项目对公司很重要，我们一定会全力以赴。
examples.en: This project matters a lot to the company, and we will give it everything we've got.

usage.en: Very common in speech, news and work contexts. Usually a predicate (我们会全力以赴) or adverbial (全力以赴地准备). Positive and earnest; often used as a promise.
usage.zh: 口语、新闻、工作场合都很常用。多作谓语、状语，如"全力以赴地准备"。含褒义，常用来表决心。

natural: The point of an awl poking out through the bag

meaning.en: To stand out from the crowd; to show one's talent and rise above the rest.
meaning.zh: 锥尖穿过布袋露出来。比喻人的才能全部显露出来，在众人中显得突出。

examples.zh: 在两百多名候选人中，她凭借出色的表现脱颖而出。
examples.en: Out of more than two hundred candidates, she stood out thanks to her excellent performance.

examples.zh: 这家小公司靠创新在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出。
examples.en: This small company rose above fierce competition through innovation.

story.en: When Lord Pingyuan of Zhao was choosing twenty retainers to go to Chu, a man named Mao Sui offered himself. Lord Pingyuan said a talented man is like an awl in a bag: its point soon shows, yet in three years he had never heard of Mao Sui. Mao Sui replied that he was only now asking to be put in the bag — had he been put in earlier, the whole awl would have broken through, not just the tip. He went, and his boldness won the alliance with Chu.
story.zh: 赵国平原君挑选二十名门客出使楚国，毛遂自荐。平原君说，有才能的人就像锥子放在口袋里，锥尖很快就会露出来，可你在我门下三年，我从没听说过你。毛遂回答："我今天才请求进入口袋，如果早放进去，整个锥子都会露出来，不只是锥尖。"后来毛遂随行，凭胆识促成了赵楚联盟。

usage.en: Predicate. Used of people, products or works that win out in a competition or selection; often with 在……中脱颖而出.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"在……中脱颖而出"。用于人、作品、产品在竞争中突出。

natural: Seeking the truth from the actual facts

meaning.en: To be realistic and practical; to base judgements on the facts rather than on wishes or dogma.
meaning.zh: 从实际情况出发，正确地对待和处理问题，不夸大也不缩小。

equivalents: keep one's feet on the ground

examples.zh: 写调查报告一定要实事求是，不能为了好看而修改数据。
examples.en: A research report must stick to the facts — you can't change the data to make it look good.

examples.zh: 我们应该实事求是地评价这次活动的效果。
examples.en: We should assess the results of this event realistically.

story.en: The Book of Han praises Liu De, Prince Xian of Hejian, for "cultivating learning and loving antiquity, seeking the truth from facts" — he collected genuine old texts and studied them carefully. In the 20th century Mao Zedong made the phrase a core political slogan, which is why it is so frequent in official Chinese.
story.zh: 《汉书》称赞河间献王刘德"修学好古，实事求是"，他搜集真正的古书并认真考证。二十世纪，毛泽东将其作为重要的思想方针，因此在官方语言中极为常见。

usage.en: Common in formal writing, politics and the workplace; also as adverbial 实事求是地. Sounds earnest and a little official.
usage.zh: 多用于正式场合、政治和工作语境，常作谓语、状语。语气严肃，略带官方色彩。

natural: Deciding what suits the particular place

meaning.en: To adapt measures to local conditions; to act according to the circumstances of a place.
meaning.zh: 根据各地的具体情况，制定适宜的办法。

examples.zh: 南方和北方气候不同，种植作物要因地制宜。
examples.en: The north and south have different climates, so what you plant has to suit the local conditions.

examples.zh: 各地学校可以因地制宜地安排课外活动。
examples.en: Schools in each region can arrange extracurricular activities to suit local circumstances.

story.en: King Helü of Wu asked his minister Wu Zixu how to make the state strong. Wu Zixu advised building walls, setting up granaries and arming the people, saying this should be done "according to the land and what suits it" (因地制宜).
story.zh: 吴王阖闾问伍子胥怎样使国家强盛，伍子胥建议修筑城郭、设立仓库、整治兵备，并说要"因地制宜"。

usage.en: Typical of policy documents, planning and news. Predicate or adverbial (因地制宜地发展). Pairs naturally with 因时制宜 (adapting to the times).
usage.zh: 多见于政策、规划和新闻，作谓语、状语。常与"因时制宜"并用。

natural: Connected breath by breath

meaning.en: Closely bound up with each other; intimately connected.
meaning.zh: 呼吸相关联。形容彼此关系非常密切。

examples.zh: 空气质量与每个人的健康息息相关。
examples.en: Air quality is closely bound up with everyone's health.

examples.zh: 这项政策和老百姓的生活息息相关，大家都很关注。
examples.en: This policy directly affects ordinary people's lives, so everyone is following it closely.

usage.en: Almost always in the pattern A 与/和 B 息息相关. Common in news, essays and speeches; can't take an object directly.
usage.zh: 常用格式："A与/和B息息相关"。多见于新闻、议论文、演讲，不能直接带宾语。

natural: Seeing what is right and bravely doing it

meaning.en: To step in bravely to help someone or stop wrongdoing; to act heroically for a just cause.
meaning.zh: 看到正义的事情就勇敢地去做，多指挺身而出帮助他人、制止坏人坏事。

examples.zh: 他在地铁上见义勇为，帮警察抓住了小偷。
examples.en: He bravely stepped in on the metro and helped the police catch a thief.

examples.zh: 学校表彰了几位见义勇为的学生。
examples.en: The school honoured several students for their courageous acts.

story.en: Confucius said: "To see what is right and not do it is a lack of courage" (见义不为，无勇也). The positive form 见义勇为 grew out of this saying.
story.zh: 孔子说："见义不为，无勇也。"意思是看到应该做的正义之事却不去做，就是没有勇气。"见义勇为"由此而来。

usage.en: Common in news and official praise; often attributive (见义勇为的英雄) or in awards (见义勇为奖). Strongly positive.
usage.zh: 新闻、表彰中常用，可作谓语、定语，如"见义勇为的英雄"。含褒义。

natural: It didn't come easily

meaning.en: Hard-won; achieved only through great effort, so it should be treasured.
meaning.zh: 得到它很不容易。多指成果、幸福等是经过艰苦努力才得来的，应当珍惜。

examples.zh: 这份工作来之不易，你要好好珍惜。
examples.en: This job wasn't easy to get, so make the most of it.

examples.zh: 今天的和平来之不易，我们不能忘记历史。
examples.en: Today's peace was hard-won; we mustn't forget history.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or attributive (来之不易的成绩). Often followed by advice to cherish it (要珍惜).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"来之不易的成绩"，后面常接"要珍惜"。

natural: The name matches the reality

meaning.en: To live up to one's name or reputation; to be truly what it is called.
meaning.zh: 名称或名声与实际相符合。

examples.zh: 这里四季如春，真是名副其实的"春城"。
examples.en: It's like spring all year round here — truly worthy of the name "Spring City".

examples.zh: 他每天读书到深夜，是名副其实的书迷。
examples.en: He reads until late every night — a bookworm in every sense of the word.

usage.en: Usually attributive in 名副其实的 + noun, or predicate. Also written 名符其实 (less standard).
usage.zh: 多作定语"名副其实的……"，也作谓语。也写作"名符其实"。

natural: Holding on firmly without letting up

meaning.en: To persevere unflaggingly; to keep at something without slacking off.
meaning.zh: 坚持到底，一点也不松懈。

examples.zh: 经过三年坚持不懈的练习，她终于能流利地说中文了。
examples.en: After three years of steady practice, she can finally speak Chinese fluently.

examples.zh: 只要坚持不懈，就一定能看到效果。
examples.en: As long as you keep at it, you'll definitely see results.

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial or attributive (坚持不懈的努力). Very common in school essays and motivational talk.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、状语、定语，如"坚持不懈的努力"。作文和励志语境中很常见。

natural: An unbroken stream that never stops

meaning.en: A continuous stream (of people, vehicles, visitors); coming and going without a break.
meaning.zh: 形容行人、车马、船只等前后相接，连续不断。

examples.zh: 国庆期间，来故宫参观的游客络绎不绝。
examples.en: During the National Day holiday there's an endless stream of visitors to the Forbidden City.

examples.zh: 新店开张那天，顾客络绎不绝。
examples.en: On the day the new shop opened, customers kept pouring in.

usage.en: Predicate describing people or traffic on the move. Not used of abstract things (use 源源不断 for supplies, ideas etc.).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容人、车、船等来往不断。不用于抽象事物（抽象事物用"源源不断"）。

natural: Beyond thought and words

meaning.en: Incredible; inconceivable; hard to imagine or explain.
meaning.zh: 原为佛教用语，指神妙奥秘，不能用心思揣度、用言语表达。现形容事物难以想象或理解。

examples.zh: 他十岁就考上了大学，真是不可思议。
examples.en: He got into university at ten — it's incredible.

examples.zh: 这么小的手机能有这么多功能，简直不可思议。
examples.en: It's mind-boggling that such a small phone can do so much.

story.en: In Buddhist scripture the phrase describes the Buddha's wisdom and powers as "inconceivable and inexpressible" — beyond what thought can grasp or words can say. Everyday usage kept the sense of "hard to believe".
story.zh: 佛经中用来形容佛的智慧与神通深奥玄妙，不能用思维揣测，也无法用语言表达。日常用法保留了"难以想象"的意思。

usage.en: Very common in speech. Predicate (真不可思议) or attributive (不可思议的事). Can express admiration or disbelief.
usage.zh: 口语常用，作谓语、定语。可表示惊叹，也可表示难以相信。

natural: With a careful and reverent heart

meaning.en: Very carefully and cautiously; gingerly.
meaning.zh: 原形容严肃恭敬的样子，现形容举动十分谨慎，一点不敢疏忽。

examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地把花瓶放到桌子上。
examples.en: She set the vase down on the table very gingerly.

examples.zh: 刚到新公司，他说话做事都小心翼翼的。
examples.en: Being new at the company, he's careful about everything he says and does.

story.en: The Book of Songs describes King Wen of Zhou: "This King Wen was careful and reverent" (维此文王，小心翼翼), serving Heaven with deep respect. The meaning later shifted from reverence to caution.
story.zh: 《诗经》描写周文王"维此文王，小心翼翼"，形容他恭敬谨慎地侍奉上天。后来意思从"恭敬"转为"谨慎"。

usage.en: Usually adverbial with 地 (小心翼翼地打开) or predicate. Can suggest timidity in some contexts.
usage.zh: 多作状语，如"小心翼翼地打开"；也作谓语。有时带有胆小的意味。

natural: Red as fire and white as reed flowers

meaning.en: In full swing; vigorous and spectacular (of campaigns, movements, events).
meaning.zh: 像火那样红，像荼那样白。原比喻军容盛大，现形容气势旺盛、气氛热烈。

examples.zh: 世界杯正如火如荼地进行着。
examples.en: The World Cup is in full swing.

examples.zh: 城市的改造工程如火如荼，到处都是工地。
examples.en: The city's redevelopment is in full swing — there are building sites everywhere.

story.en: Before a battle with Jin, King Fuchai of Wu arranged his army in squares: one wearing white with white banners, "white as the reed flower" (荼), another all in red, "red as fire". The overwhelming sight cowed the enemy.
story.zh: 吴王夫差与晋国争霸时，把军队排成方阵：一方阵穿白衣、举白旗，"望之如荼"；另一方阵全身红色，"望之如火"。声势浩大，震慑了对方。

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (如火如荼地进行/开展). Formal; mostly news and writing about events and campaigns. 荼 is tú, not chá.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，如"如火如荼地进行"。书面语，多用于活动、运动。"荼"读 tú，不读 chá。

natural: Clear at a single glance

meaning.en: Clear at a glance; obvious immediately.
meaning.zh: 看一眼就清楚了。形容事物简单明白。

examples.zh: 用图表展示数据，读者会一目了然。
examples.en: If you show the data in a chart, readers will see it at a glance.

examples.zh: 这份说明书写得一目了然。
examples.en: These instructions are completely self-explanatory.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (写得一目了然). Common for designs, charts, explanations. In speech 一 is said yí here (before 4th-tone 目).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，如"写得一目了然"。口语中"一"在第四声"目"前读 yí。

natural: Holding to it with constancy

meaning.en: To persevere; to keep something up steadily over a long time.
meaning.zh: 长久地坚持下去。

equivalents: slow and steady wins the race

examples.zh: 锻炼身体贵在持之以恒。
examples.en: With exercise, what matters is keeping it up.

examples.zh: 学外语没有捷径，只有持之以恒。
examples.en: There are no shortcuts to learning a language — only steady persistence.

usage.en: Predicate; very common in the pattern 贵在持之以恒 (the key is to persevere). Often in advice and essays.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"贵在持之以恒"。多用于劝勉和作文。

natural: Thousands upon tens of thousands

meaning.en: Thousands and thousands; a huge number.
meaning.zh: 形容数量非常多。

examples.zh: 每年都有成千上万的人来这里看樱花。
examples.en: Every year, thousands upon thousands of people come here to see the cherry blossom.

examples.zh: 这个视频被成千上万的网友转发。
examples.en: The video was shared by countless people online.

usage.en: Usually attributive: 成千上万的 + noun. Neutral; spoken and written. Also 成千成万.
usage.zh: 多作定语"成千上万的……"。口语书面语都用。也说"成千成万"。

natural: Living in peace and working contentedly

meaning.en: To live in peace and work happily; (of a population) settled and content.
meaning.zh: 安定地生活，愉快地工作。

examples.zh: 政府的目标是让百姓安居乐业。
examples.en: The government's aim is for people to live and work in peace and contentment.

examples.zh: 战争结束后，这里的人们终于可以安居乐业了。
examples.en: After the war ended, people here could at last settle down and live in peace.

story.en: The idea goes back to the Laozi's ideal society where people are "content with their dwellings and happy in their customs". The Book of Han puts it as people "each at peace in their homes and happy in their work" (各安其居而乐其业).
story.zh: 这一理想源于《老子》"安其居，乐其俗"。《汉书·货殖传》说"各安其居而乐其业"，后来凝练为"安居乐业"。

usage.en: Predicate. Typically about a population or society, in politics, history and news; rarely about one person.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指一方百姓或社会，用于政治、历史、新闻，很少用于个人。

natural: With one's whole heart and mind

meaning.en: Wholeheartedly; with complete devotion.
meaning.zh: 用全部的精力，没有一点杂念。

equivalents: with every fibre of one's being

examples.zh: 她全心全意地照顾生病的母亲。
examples.en: She looks after her sick mother with complete devotion.

examples.zh: 我们要全心全意为顾客服务。
examples.en: We must serve our customers wholeheartedly.

story.en: The phrase was popularised by Mao Zedong's 1944 speech "Serve the People", which calls for serving the people "wholeheartedly" (全心全意地为人民服务) — still a famous slogan.
story.zh: 毛泽东1944年在《为人民服务》中提出"全心全意地为人民服务"，这一说法由此广为流传，至今仍是著名口号。

usage.en: Usually adverbial (全心全意地 + verb). Common in speech and writing; sometimes sounds like a slogan.
usage.zh: 多作状语，如"全心全意地工作"。口语书面语都用，有时带口号色彩。

natural: Only one, there is no second

meaning.en: Unique; one of a kind.
meaning.zh: 只有一个，没有第二个。形容非常特别，没有可以相比的。

examples.zh: 每个人都是独一无二的。
examples.en: Everyone is unique.

examples.zh: 这件手工做的瓷器独一无二。
examples.en: This handmade porcelain piece is one of a kind.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (独一无二的作品). Very common in speech and advertising.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"独一无二的作品"。口语和广告中很常见。

natural: Five flowery formations and eight gates

meaning.en: All kinds of; a bewildering variety.
meaning.zh: 比喻花样繁多，变化多端。

examples.zh: 夜市上卖的小吃五花八门。
examples.en: The night market sells every snack you can imagine.

examples.zh: 网上的说法五花八门，很难判断真假。
examples.en: Online there are all sorts of claims, and it's hard to tell what's true.

story.en: A traditional explanation is that 五花 and 八门 were two battle formations in old military lore: the 五行阵 ("five elements" formation) and the 八门阵 ("eight gates" formation), both famous for their endless changes. Later the phrase came to mean "all kinds of".
story.zh: 传统说法认为"五花""八门"原是古代兵法中的两种阵法——"五行阵"和"八门阵"，以变化多端著称，后来比喻花样繁多。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (五花八门的……). Neutral to slightly negative when it implies confusion.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。中性，暗示杂乱时略带贬义。

natural: Born in response to the times

meaning.en: To emerge in response to circumstances; to arise because the times call for it.
meaning.zh: 原指应天命而降生，现指适应时代或形势的需要而产生。

examples.zh: 随着网购的普及，快递行业应运而生。
examples.en: As online shopping spread, the courier industry sprang up to meet the demand.

examples.zh: 老龄化社会到来，各种养老服务应运而生。
examples.en: With an ageing society, all kinds of elderly-care services have emerged.

usage.en: Predicate, usually after a clause explaining the cause (随着……，……应运而生). Formal; news and essays.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，前面常有说明原因的分句，如"随着……，……应运而生"。书面语。

natural: Seen so often it's nothing new

meaning.en: Common; nothing new or unusual because it happens so often.
meaning.zh: 经常见到，并不新奇。

examples.zh: 这种网络诈骗已经屡见不鲜了。
examples.en: This kind of online scam is nothing new any more.

examples.zh: 雨季道路积水的情况在这里屡见不鲜。
examples.en: Flooded roads in the rainy season are all too common here.

story.en: Lu Jia told his sons he would visit each of them in turn, but not too often: "If I come too often, you won't kill fresh meat for me" (数见不鲜). The original meant a frequent guest no longer gets fresh dishes; it later came to mean "so frequent it's not new".
story.zh: 陆贾对儿子们说，他会轮流去各家住，但不会常去，"数见不鲜"——常去就不会为他宰杀新鲜的禽兽了。后来意思变为"经常见到，不觉新奇"。

usage.en: Predicate, often with 已经 / 并不. Usually about negative phenomena. 屡 is lǚ (also written 数见不鲜).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"已经""并不"连用，多指不好的现象。也作"数见不鲜"。

natural: Never seen before

meaning.en: Unprecedented; never happened before.
meaning.zh: 以前从来没有过的。

examples.zh: 这次疫情给全球经济带来了前所未有的挑战。
examples.en: The pandemic brought unprecedented challenges to the global economy.

examples.zh: 今年的报名人数达到了前所未有的水平。
examples.en: This year's applications reached a record level.

usage.en: Mostly attributive (前所未有的 + noun) or 达到前所未有的…. Common in news.
usage.zh: 多作定语，如"前所未有的挑战"。新闻中常见。

natural: Frost added on top of snow

meaning.en: One disaster after another; to make a bad situation worse.
meaning.zh: 在雪上又加了一层霜。比喻接连遭受灾难，损害愈加严重。

examples.zh: 他刚丢了工作，又生了病，真是雪上加霜。
examples.en: He'd just lost his job, and then he fell ill — when it rains, it pours.

examples.zh: 原材料涨价，对困难中的小企业来说无异于雪上加霜。
examples.en: Rising raw-material prices make things even worse for struggling small businesses.

usage.en: Predicate or object (无异于雪上加霜). Always negative. Contrast 锦上添花 (icing on the cake).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，如"无异于雪上加霜"。含贬义。与"锦上添花"相对。

natural: Feet planted on solid ground

meaning.en: Down-to-earth; doing things steadily and practically, step by step.
meaning.zh: 脚踏在坚实的土地上。比喻做事踏实认真。

equivalents: keep one's feet on the ground

examples.zh: 创业不能只靠想法，还要脚踏实地地去做。
examples.en: Starting a business takes more than ideas — you have to put in the work step by step.

examples.zh: 他是个脚踏实地的人，从不说空话。
examples.en: He's a down-to-earth person who never makes empty promises.

story.en: The Northern Song statesman Sima Guang is recorded as praising the philosopher Shao Yong as a man who "treads on solid ground" (脚踏实地) — sincere and practical rather than given to empty talk.
story.zh: 据《邵氏闻见录》记载，北宋司马光称赞哲学家邵雍是"脚踏实地"的人，为人诚恳务实，不说空话。

usage.en: Adverbial (脚踏实地地工作), attributive or predicate. Common in advice and character descriptions.
usage.zh: 可作状语、定语、谓语，如"脚踏实地地工作"。常用于劝勉和评价人。
